title: DIAL-S2ST: Learning Latency Control for Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose DIAL-S2ST, a post-training method for learning inference-time latency control in simultaneous speech-to-speech translation models. Our approach reuses pretrained translation capabilities through self-distillation from lookahead predictions, while limiting the influence of large text distillation losses to account for the imitation gap. This provides supervision for earlier emission without paired target data or reward computation. To make the learned timing adjustable at inference, we jointly train a single LoRA adapter across scales with matched lookahead guidance. Experiments on French-to-English translation with Hibiki demonstrate that only 10 hours of source speech enable this adaptation, providing flexible latency control with a favorable quality-latency trade-off.

translated_title: DIAL-S2ST：面向同声语音到语音翻译的延迟控制学习方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DIAL-S2ST，这是一种后训练方法，用于在同声语音到语音翻译模型中学习推理时的延迟控制。我们的方法通过对前瞻预测进行自蒸馏来复用预训练的翻译能力，同时限制大型文本蒸馏损失的影响，以应对模仿差距。这为更早的输出提供了监督，而无需配对目标数据或奖励计算。为了使学习到的输出时机在推理时可调节，我们在匹配的前瞻引导下跨多个尺度联合训练单个LoRA适配器。基于Hibiki的法语到英语翻译实验表明，仅需10小时的源语音即可实现这种适配，提供了灵活的延迟控制和良好的质量-延迟权衡。
tldr: 提出DIAL-S2ST后训练方法，通过前瞻预测自蒸馏学习同声语音到语音翻译模型的推理时延迟控制，仅需10小时源语音即可实现灵活的延迟调节与良好的质量-延迟权衡。
en_tdlr: DIAL-S2ST learns inference-time latency control for simultaneous speech-to-speech translation through post-training with self-distillation from lookahead predictions, enabling flexible latency adjustment with only 10 hours of source speech and a favorable quality-latency trade-off.
